claim: The bug was in the shortName() function
shortName() is located at index.html line 5868
shortName() only kept a preceding word as part of the surname if it started with a lowercase letter
Capitalized surname particles like Del, Di, De, Le, Mac got dropped by the original implementation
Del Piero was affected by the bug
Di María was affected by the bug
De Bruyne was affected by the bug
A NAME_PARTICLES set of common surname prefixes was added
The fix checks NAME_PARTICLES membership case-insensitively alongside the existing lowercase check
Del Piero now resolves correctly after the fix
De Bruyne now resolves correctly after the fix
Di María now resolves correctly after the fix
Mac Allister now resolves correctly after the fix
Asamoah is unaffected by the fix
Conte is unaffected by the fix
Ronaldo is unaffected by the fix
